description: GPU KV cache pressure, prefix caching, KV block residency, and KV transfer and offloading through KV connectors.

panels.title: Max KV cache usage
panels.description:
GPU KV cache usage of the most loaded engine.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

targets.expr: max(vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Mean KV cache usage
panels.description:
Mean GPU KV cache usage across engines.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

targets.expr: avg(vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description:
Share of looked-up prompt tokens found in the local prefix cache.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total`, `vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Cached prompt tokens
panels.description:
Share of prompt tokens that skipped prefill because their KV was cached locally or loaded through a KV connector.

Metrics: `vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_total`, `vllm:prompt_tokens_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Preemptions / s
panels.description:
Running requests evicted to free KV cache.

Metric: `vllm:num_preemptions_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Waiting for capacity
panels.description:
Requests waiting for KV cache or batch capacity.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason`

targets.expr: sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", reason="capacity"})

panels.title: KV cache usage by engine
panels.description:
GPU KV cache usage of each engine.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

targets.expr: max by (instance, engine) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Scheduler queue
panels.description:
Requests being executed and requests waiting to be scheduled. *capacity*: waiting for KV cache or batch capacity. *deferred*: held back by a transient constraint such as the LoRA budget or a pending KV transfer.

Metrics: `vllm:num_requests_running`, `vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason`

targets.expr: sum(vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", reason="capacity"})
sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", reason="deferred"})

panels.title: Preemptions / s by engine
panels.description:
Requests preempted per second on each engine.

Metric: `vllm:num_preemptions_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prompt tokens by source
panels.description:
Where prompt tokens came from: computed by prefill, reused from the local prefix cache, or loaded from another instance or an external cache through a KV connector.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", source="local_compute"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", source="local_cache_hit"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", source="external_kv_transfer"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate by engine
panels.description:
Share of looked-up prompt tokens found in each engine's prefix cache.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total`, `vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Cached prompt tokens by tier
panels.description:
Prompt tokens served from cache, by the tier that held them: *device* (GPU memory), *host* (CPU memory), *disk*, *p2p* (another vLLM instance) or *external_unspecified*.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_by_source_total`

targets.expr: sum by (source) (rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_by_source_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Prompt and computed tokens per request
panels.description:
Mean prompt length against the tokens prefill actually had to compute. The gap is the work saved by caching.

Metrics: `vllm:request_prompt_tokens`, `vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Cache hit rates
panels.description:
Share of looked-up tokens (prefix caches) or items (multimodal cache) that were already cached. *external* is the KV connector's cross-instance cache and only appears when one is configured.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total`, `vllm:external_prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total`, `vllm:mm_cache_{hits,queries}_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(vllm:mm_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:mm_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Block lifetime
panels.description:
Time from a KV block's allocation to its eviction. Sampled per `--kv-cache-metrics-sample`.

Metric: `vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Idle time before eviction
panels.description:
Time an evicted KV block went unused before eviction. Short idle times mean useful blocks are evicted under pressure. Sampled per `--kv-cache-metrics-sample`.

Metric: `vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Block reuse gap
panels.description:
Time between consecutive accesses of a KV block. Sampled per `--kv-cache-metrics-sample`.

Metric: `vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: External prefix cache hit rate
panels.description:
Share of tokens looked up through the KV connector that another instance or an external cache could provide.

Metrics: `vllm:external_prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Requests waiting on KV loads
panels.description:
Waiting requests on a KV consumer by async load stage: not started, in progress, or finished but not yet running.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_kv_fetch_by_stage`

targets.expr: sum by (stage) (vllm:num_requests_kv_fetch_by_stage{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Prompt tokens loaded via KV transfer
panels.description:
Prompt tokens whose KV came from the KV connector instead of being computed.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", source="external_kv_transfer"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Transfer duration
panels.description:
Duration of NIXL KV cache transfers.

Metric: `vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Transfer throughput
panels.description:
KV cache bytes moved per second, and the mean bandwidth of a single transfer (bytes / transfer duration).

Metrics: `vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred`, `vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Transfers / s
panels.description:
Completed NIXL transfers per second.

Metric: `vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Bytes per transfer
panels.description:
Size of NIXL KV cache transfers.

Metric: `vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Transfer post time
panels.description:
Time to post a NIXL transfer request.

Metric: `vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Descriptors per transfer
panels.description:
Memory descriptors per NIXL transfer. Many small descriptors make transfers inefficient.

Metric: `vllm:nixl_num_descriptors`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Transfer failures / s
panels.description:
*failed transfers* includes handshake and notification failures. *expired KV* counts requests whose KV lease expired on the prefill instance; *late notifications* arrived after expiry, so the KV blocks may already have been reused.

Metrics: `vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers_total`, `vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications_total`, `vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs_total`, `vllm:nixl_num_notifications_after_expiry_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:nixl_num_notifications_after_expiry_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Offload throughput
panels.description:
Bytes moved per second between GPU memory and the offload medium. *load*: offload to GPU; *store*: GPU to offload.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes_total`, `vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Offload transfer bandwidth
panels.description:
Bytes moved per second of transfer time: the effective bandwidth of offload loads and stores.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_{load,store}_{bytes,time}_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_load_time_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_store_time_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Mean offload transfer size
panels.description:
Mean size of one offload load or store operation.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_load_size`, `vllm:kv_offload_store_size`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_load_size_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_load_size_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_store_size_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_store_size_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Offload lookup latency p99
panels.description:
*sync*: one offload lookup call. *async*: from a lookup first deferring until it resolves or the request finishes.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_lookup_{sync,async}_delay_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_offload_lookup_sync_delay_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:kv_offload_lookup_async_delay_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CPU offload buffer usage
panels.description:
Share of the CPU KV cache pinned by in-flight transfers. Sustained high values mean stores or promotions may be dropped.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_usage_perc`, `vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_{write,read}_usage_perc`

targets.expr: max(vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
max(vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_write_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
max(vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_read_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Failed and skipped stores / s
panels.description:
*allocation failures*: stores that could not get offload space. *skipped*: stores below the configured reuse threshold.

Metrics: `vllm:kv_offload_allocation_failure_total`, `vllm:kv_offload_stores_skipped_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_allocation_failure_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(vllm:kv_offload_stores_skipped_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Store admission outcomes
panels.description:
Store admission decisions by outcome (eager-mode hand-off stores only).

Metric: `vllm:simple_kv_offload_save_outcomes_total`

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(vllm:simple_kv_offload_save_outcomes_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Blocks restored from offload / s
panels.description:
KV blocks loaded back to GPU from the offload pool: prefill work avoided by offload cache hits.

Metric: `vllm:simple_kv_offload_load_blocks_total`

targets.expr: sum(rate(vllm:simple_kv_offload_load_blocks_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Offload pool blocks
panels.description:
Pool blocks pinned by in-flight transfers or cache hits, and blocks in pending stores. A steadily growing pending count indicates a stuck transfer. The pool size is the `capacity_blocks` label of `vllm:simple_kv_offload_info`.

Metrics: `vllm:simple_kv_offload_used_blocks`, `vllm:simple_kv_offload_pending_store_blocks`

targets.expr: sum(vllm:simple_kv_offload_used_blocks{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum(vllm:simple_kv_offload_pending_store_blocks{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

title: vLLM / KV Cache
